title: Guard core: cmd/guard skeleton, arch + lint subcommands, committed thresholds, G-L verify rows, CI gauntlet gates job
objective: Implement the deterministic guard stack core: a stdlib-only cmd/guard with the frozen JSON contract and machine-code registry, arch and lint subcommands proving §17.3 and the L1/L2 lint floors offline, every §3.5 threshold committed in .agent/guards.json, fail-closed guard.arch/guard.lint verify rows at gate G-L, an additive CI gauntlet gates job, and matching selftest scenarios (design §5, FJ-056 row).
acceptance: cmd/guard runs offline with stdlib only and emits the frozen JSON contract {check, findings[], stats{}}; usage, unknown check, malformed or missing thresholds exit 2 with stdout empty
guard arch proves .agent/guards.json forbidden-import rules (exact whole-string and raw-prefix semantics) with stable finding codes, skipping skipDirs
guard lint proves err_discarded (L1) and unsafe_type_assert (L2) via go/types with GOPROXY=off-safe import resolution
.agent/guards.json is committed with every §3.5 threshold (arch, lint, complexity, mutation, trace, fuzz) and unknown JSON fields fail closed
verify-candidate gains fail-closed guard.arch/guard.lint rows at gate G-L with the stage.not_required metadata na rows (interpretation notes 1-3)
CI gains an additive gauntlet gates job running ./scripts/verify-candidate; the §23 mandated jobs stay untouched
selftest gains the eight guard arch/lint scenarios; full battery green and task-less ./scripts/verify-candidate exits 0
nonGoals: do not implement complexity or mutation floors (FJ-044/FJ-045)
do not add or remove any dependency
do not weaken or delete any existing selftest scenario
